sections.text: مقدمة

This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block
Passenger elevator is working between six floors (floor 0.1.3.4.5&6)

It's 
considered as an essential load so it will be supplied by emergency diesel

The car 
door is working automatically with the floor door.

The first draft initiated by eng. Hassan Moussa Hassan, tested by eng. Ramadan 
Farrag Ahmad, reviewed by: eng. Mohamed Nasr El-Din, and approved by eng. 
Youssef Mahmoud Aly : general director of Esna hydraulic power station and 
certified by eng. Kamel Raghib Hakem: HEPC inspection & quality control and MPIS 
coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة
يجب إصدار تصريح العمل.

الصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة الأمان المناسبة للهوية

Wear the personal safety and healthy protective equipment as safety shoes, 
 helmet, ...etc
تتم الصيانة بالتعاون مع القسم الميكانيكي.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

قم بإيقاف تشغيل العرض 
مصعد ركاب من غرفة MCC ومن غرفة المصاعد

Using vaccum cleaner to 
clean the motors filter and modules` cabinet.

Turn on the supply of the 
elevator from mcc & elevator room.

Change the control mode to 
"inspection" from the switch on the top of the car.

Review all limit & 
magnetic switches on the car and their cams inside the elevator pit for all 
floors visually and adjust their position if needed.

Change the control mode to 
"normal" from the switch on the car.

Test open & close all 
doors in all floors automatically.

مراجعة ضبط الخلية الكهروضوئية 
وربطه إذا لزم الأمر.

Reviewing all motors & the 
lighting of the car is carried out by general auxiliries department.

Test calling the car in 
all floors.

الخدمة.

sections_en.text: Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block
Passenger elevator is working between six floors (floor 0.1.3.4.5&6)
It's considered as an essential load so it will be supplied by emergency diesel
The car door is working automatically with the floor door.

The first draft initiated by eng. Hassan Moussa Hassan, tested by eng. Ramadan Farrag Ahmad, reviewed by: eng. Mohamed Nasr El-Din, and approved by eng. Youssef Mahmoud Aly : general director of Esna hydraulic power station and certified by eng. Kamel Raghib Hakem: HEPC inspection & quality control and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable safety category card.
Wear the personal safety and healthy protective equipment as safety shoes, helmet, ...etc
Maintenance is carried out in cooperation with the mechanical department.

sections_en.text: Work to be Carried Out
Switch off the passenger elevator supply from the MCC room and from the elevator room.
Using vaccum cleaner to clean the motors filter and modules` cabinet.
Turn on the supply of the elevator from mcc & elevator room.
Change the control mode to "inspection" from the switch on the top of the car.
Review all limit & magnetic switches on the car and their cams inside the elevator pit for all floors visually and adjust their position if needed.
Change the control mode to "normal" from the switch on the car.
Test open & close all doors in all floors automatically.
Check the setting of the photocell and adjust it if necessary.
Reviewing all motors & the lighting of the car is carried out by general auxiliries department.
Test calling the car in all floors.
Put the elevator in service.
